subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

We deplore the use of ______ against innocent people.
solution:
The correct answer is: **violence**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Reduction**: The action or fact of making something smaller or less in amount, degree, or size. (कमी)
 
• **Violence**: Behaviour involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something. (हिंसा)
 
• **Gentleness**: The quality of being kind, tender, or mild-mannered. (सज्जनता)
 
• **Humour**: The quality of being amusing or comic, especially as expressed in literature or speech. (हास्य)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**violence**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "Violence against defenceless individuals is something we despise."

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete sentence: *We deplore the use of violence __against innocent people.*
